crossRefs.note: “I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was ancient of days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair…

After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great…
Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of…
I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness…
They went up over the width of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. Fire came down…
But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.’

Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man…

that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever.…
He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father…
and made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign on the earth.”

translations.web: until the ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.
translations.bsb: until the Ancient of Days arrived and pronounced judgment in favor of the saints of the Most High, and the time came for them to possess the kingdom.
translations.kjv: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.
translations.asv: until the ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.
